method: Read all nine complete feasibility rows and all six retained title-excerpt sets. Rechecked all six exact primary URLs with the read-only web tool, then followed the two relevant town-planner route links. No browser/UI or full library reconstruction.
decision_rules: Explicit apprenticeship wording and the primary-page apprenticeship context establish occupational training intent for the complete literal.
Property-service, buyer/rental and general guide intent remains protected; profession words alone are not proposed exclusions.
Published wording alone does not establish distinct concepts. Ordinals 1 and 7 are treated as one route group with one actual candidate representative.
Shared subjects alone do not merge genuinely different published occupational specialisms or explicit level/role routes.
No title is shortened, permuted, suffixed or manufactured; no metrics, demand or observed-query claim is made.
All proposals remain subject to root evaluation, complete current-library/protection/scope checks and separate human exclusion/release authority.
